hazards.description: A large white truck with a flatbed rack is parked at the curb, significantly blocking the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the road.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, parked along the curb line.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The narrow sidewalk is immediately adjacent to the curb with no physical separation from parked or moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both curbs can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street along the curb

hazards.name: Lack of raised curb
hazards.description: The absence of a vertical curb allows vehicles to more easily encroach upon the pedestrian buffer and sidewalk area.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edge of the roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left side of the image ends abruptly, and there is no visible sidewalk on the right side, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left and right sides

hazards.name: Undefined Vehicle Access
hazards.description: The right side of the street has an open frontage where vehicles can enter or exit the property across the entire block, creating multiple conflict points.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image adjacent to the commercial building

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: There is no physical buffer, such as a planting strip or street furniture, between the sidewalk and the active travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line

hazards.name: Absence of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible, which may lead to poor visibility and safety concerns for pedestrians after dark.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the streetscape.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at intersections or mid-block to improve visibility and reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement high-visibility continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly designate pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the parking lane to enhance pedestrian comfort and provide a physical barrier.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow vehicle speeds and increase pedestrian prominence.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalk along the block to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds on this wide, residential street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions / Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install vertical speed control measures to maintain low vehicle speeds in a residential area with high parking density.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees in the buffer zone would provide shade and create a vertical sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to ensure the sidewalk and roadway are well-illuminated for nighttime safety.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or curb extensions to naturally slow traffic in this residential context.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add paint markings to define travel lanes and parking areas, narrowing the perceived width of the road to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearance
interventions.description: Implement and enforce policies to keep sidewalks clear of trash and debris to ensure a safe, unobstructed path for all users.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a standard-width concrete sidewalk on the left side of the street to complete the pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a buffer between the sidewalk and traffic, and to improve the aesthetic quality of the blank frontage.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip to provide a physical buffer from traffic and improve the microclimate.

interventions.title: Wall Art or Murals
interventions.description: Utilize the blank wall for public art to improve the visual interest and perceived safety of the corridor.

interventions.title: Install Concrete Curbing
interventions.description: Adding a standard vertical curb would provide better physical separation and protection for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Adding street trees in the buffer zone would improve the pedestrian environment and act as a vertical element to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Facade Improvements
interventions.description: Incorporate murals or architectural elements to the blank wall to improve the visual environment and reduce the sense of isolation.
